c.description:
3 Bedroom 3 Bathroom Detached House in Dunbar, Vancouver Westside

Prime location in Vancouver's desirable Dunbar neighbourhood, this charming 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom detached house is situated in a quiet residential area.

The home features a bright and spacious living room with a cozy fireplace, beautiful hardwood flooring, a functional kitchen and dining area, and comfortable bedrooms. Large windows provide plenty of natural light throughout the home.

Conveniently located near UBC, Pacific Spirit Regional Park, local shops, restaurants, schools, and public transportation. Enjoy peaceful residential living with easy access to everything Vancouver Westside has to offer.

Rental Details:

• Lease Term: Minimum 1-year lease
• Unfurnished (furniture shown in photos is not included)
• Utilities not included
• Tenant insurance is mandatory

Credit, income, and reference checks will be conducted.

Property professionally managed by Hooli Homes Realty.
